I ended up Mandalore mostly by accident.|[[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>}}
'''Clan Vizla''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan active during the era of the [[Galactic War]]. [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] and her [[Shae Vizla's brother|brother]] were part of the clan, as was [[Gen Vizla]].

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] Shae settled on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] and established a base on the [[Tracyn Island]], where she was joined by members of other Mandalorian clans such as [[Jos Beroya|Jos]] and [[Valk Beroya]] from [[Clan Beroya]]. The clans tested themselves against fearsome creatures kept in the enclave on the island and worked with the [[Nova Blades]] for a time, but broke ties with them when the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] allied with the [[Order of Revan]].

[[File:Shae_of_Clan_Vizla.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Shae Vizla, Mandalore the Avenger]]
During the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] of the galaxy, the Mandalorians fought back and [[Mandalore the Vindicated]] was killed in combat. Many of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] were blockaded by the [[Eternal Fleet]] and the [[Star Fortress]]es, trapping almost half of all Mandalorian clans on those worlds. Clan Vizla survived better than most others and Shae Vizla was chosen as the new "[[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] the Avenger", a title she reluctantly accepted.
